analysis.summary: Candidate RL-P03 demonstrates foundational product analyst experience in user discovery, basic error reviews, and classical A/B experimentation within an e-commerce context. However, significant preparation is required to build technical depth in core model lifecycle processes, including repeatable AI evaluation systems, retrieval and training tradeoffs, and AI safety practices.
